answer: Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter: we confirm the payoff directly with Meridian the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. You also don't need the title in hand while the loan is open, since the lender holds it, and we pay Meridian off directly from your offer. The help center doesn't cover how to get a car that doesn't run to us (such as towing or pickup), so please contact a store about that part.
